description: Paste a proposal, quote, estimate, contract, or email thread. ScopeLinq reads it into the terms it actually states, each traced to the words it came from, and tells you what the text doesn't say. Confirm the lines that were agreed, then ask whether a new request is Included, Additional work, or Needs clarification — the answer cites only lines you confirmed. Works for whoever sent the document or whoever received it. Free, no account.

defaultPrompt: Here's the proposal I was sent — what does it actually commit them to, and what doesn't it say?
We agreed on these terms. They're now asking for something else — is it included?
Read this quote and tell me what it doesn't mention before I agree to it.
